description: Search retailers (shops) registered on authorized.by, or list them all. Read-only. 'search' matches the company name, alias or shop domain (partial match): a URL is reduced to its domain, except on marketplace hosts such as amazon.de or ebay.de, where the store path is kept and the bare host lists every seller. A partial match can find other shops (shop.de also finds myshop.de), so compare shop_url with the domain you are checking; to verify one shop against a brand, use verify_retailer_authorization. Returns for each retailer: id, name, slug, shop URL, logo, the number of brands that authorized it, and certificate_url / certificate_url_de: links to the retailer's public authorized.by certificate page (English / German) listing all brands that authorized it; null when the retailer has no active authorization. Omit 'search' to retrieve the full index; use 'page' and 'size' to paginate. Data scope: results only cover relationships registered and confirmed on authorized.by. An empty result or a not-found error does NOT prove that no authorization exists outside authorized.by. Distinguish outcomes: an empty list means no matching record on authorized.by; an error result whose text starts with 'Brand not found' or 'Retailer not found' means the given id/alias is unknown; an error result whose text starts with 'Tool execution failed' is a technical error and says nothing about the data.

search.description: Filter by retailer company name, alias or shop domain/URL, e.g. 'best-shop' or 'best-shop.de'. Optional.

name: get_retailers

outputSchema.description: A page of retailers plus network-wide totals and pagination.

total_brands.description: Total number of public brands on authorized.by.

total_connections.description: Total number of active brand-retailer authorizations on authorized.by.

total_retailers.description: Total number of public retailers on authorized.by.

page.description: Zero-based page number of this response.

size.description: Page size used for this response.

total_items.description: Total number of matching entries across all pages.

brand_count.description: Number of brands with a public, approved profile that currently authorize this retailer on authorized.by. Only authorizations confirmed by both the brand and the retailer count; pending requests and ended authorizations do not.

certificate_url.description: Public authorized.by certificate page (English) that proves the authorization: of this brand and retailer where the entry is about both, otherwise the retailer's page listing all brands that authorize it. Null when there is no active authorization.

certificate_url_de.description: Same certificate page in German; null when there is no active authorization.

description.description: Description text in German (de) and English (en); each may be null.

opening_hours.description: Weekly opening hours of the physical store; empty or null when unknown.

payment_methods.description: Accepted payment methods; null when unknown.

registration_date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the retailer registered on authorized.by.

social.description: Social media profile URLs; each may be null.

tuv_certification_date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the TÜV Saarland ShopIdent verification of the shop's identity was approved; null when there is none. It does not say how long the verification remains valid.

id.description: Numeric authorized.by ID. Accepted by the id_or_alias argument of the detail tools.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier. Accepted by the id_or_alias argument of the detail tools.

title: Search retailers
